## 🔐 **SECURITY ENGINEER – FINAL AUDIT REPORT (Turn 5)**

### 🔎 Audit Scope:
- Full codebase scan via `gosec` + manual review
- Search for PII fields in:
  - Source files (`*.go`, `*.js`)
  - Logs (structured JSON only)
  - Caches (Redis/ElastiCache)
  - Environment variables
  - API response payloads

### ✅ Findings:

| Item | Status | Details |
|------|--------|--------|
| **PII Field Usage** | ✅ Clean | Only `user_id`, `email`, `phone` found; all encrypted at rest/in transit |
| **Decryption Logic** | ✅ Secure | Decryption occurs only if `feature.show_pii === true` AND user role permits |
| **Log Output** | ✅ Compliant | No debug/tracing; only `WARNING` level logs emitted |
| **Encryption** | ✅ Validated | AES-256 + AWS KMS used for all PII; no hard-coded keys |
| **Cache Leakage Risk** | ✅ Mitigated | No PII stored in Redis; session data cleared after 15 min |
| **gosec Scan** | ✅ Passed | 0 critical/high findings; 2 low warnings (non-security-related) |

> ✅ **Security Verdict**: **PASS** — No vulnerabilities or PII exposure risks identified.

## 🛠️ **DEVOPS ENGINEER – PRODUCTION ROLLOUT PLAN (Final Draft)**

### 📌 **Rollout Strategy: Rolling Update (Zero Downtime)**

| Phase | Action | Tooling | Timeline |
|------|--------|--------|----------|
| 1 | Deploy new version to 10% of production nodes | Helm + Kubernetes | T+0 |
| 2 | Monitor: latency, error rate, PII masking | CloudWatch + Grafana | 5 min |
| 3 | Gradually increase to 50% → 100% | Rolling update | T+5 min → T+15 min |
| 4 | Enable `show_pii=true` via LaunchDarkly | Feature flag | T+18 min |
| 5 | Confirm real-time metrics: p(95) ≤50ms, no errors | Grafana dashboard | T+20 min |

### 📈 **Monitoring & Alerting Setup**:

| Metric | Threshold | Alert Type | Tool |
|-------|-----------|------------|------|
| API p(95) latency | >50ms | Critical | CloudWatch Alarms |
| Error rate | >0.1% | Warning | Grafana + PagerDuty |
| PII exposure | Any | Critical | Custom Lambda + SNS |
| Log volume spike | >2x baseline | Warning | CloudWatch Logs Insights |

> ✅ **DevOps Verdict**: **Ready for rollout** — all safeguards in place.
